entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: So you're finally up, huh? Don't slack off[n]just 'cause you're on summer vacation.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yo, you look tired.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We've made ourselves at home.

entries.speaker: TV Reporter
entries.en: Late last night, it was discovered that[n]someone has tampered with the hacker[n]group Medjed's website.

entries.speaker: TV Reporter
entries.en: The site's main page now displays what[n]is thought to be the mark belonging to[n]the Phantom Thieves...

entries.speaker: TV Reporter
entries.en: Moreso, the personal information of[n]a Japanese man, a possible Medjed[n]member, was illegally publicized.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Aren't these the guys people have been[n]up in arms about?

entries.speaker: TV Reporter
entries.en: Medjed has yet to issue an official reply.

entries.speaker: TV Reporter
entries.en: Furthermore, their previously announced[n]cleanse of Japan has remained[n]unimplemented for now.

entries.speaker: TV Reporter
entries.en: Some speculate that they have taken this[n]series of events seriously and ultimately[n]canceled their plan.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: What're you all smirking about?
Nothing.
Something great happened.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Well stop it. You're gonna drive away[n]all my customers.

entries.speaker: TV Reporter
entries.en: After the commercial break, we will be[n]asking guests from various fields about[n]this turn of events.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But there ain't any customers.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Can it...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: My customers are on summer vacation[n]too.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh crap, I just realized our break's[n]almost over!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: There are still ten days left.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I wanna go somewhere, but we can't just[n]leave Futaba-chan alone.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Some things still concern me too, like that[n]"research"...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Oh! Did you just get up?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Good morning.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It seems she's cautious of us...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hey, why don't we go upstairs?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: If any customers come, she'll be even[n]more afraid.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Why don't you go with them, Futaba?[n]Have fun.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: It's about time my regulars show up[n]anyway, so I don't want you guys[n]loitering around my store.

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: The fact that there were no damages[n]due to the hackers' actions is but an[n]afterthought.

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: The issue I want to make clear is the[n]attitude of the police, and more[n]importantly, the government.

entries.speaker: TV Reporter
entries.en: What do you mean?

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: Are they doing their best to find an[n]effective countermeasure against[n]these Phantom Thieves?

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: Is it not the government's duty to create[n]a society where its citizens can live[n]without worry?

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: Unfortunately, the current cabinet is[n]powerless. As such, they should be[n]disbanded.

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: I believe now is the time for me to risk[n]my political career in hope of making[n]a new reality.

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: A new political system that goes beyond[n]parties or factions... An ideal country of[n]peace and order...

entries.speaker: Elderly Male Customer
entries.en: This politician seems quite promising.

entries.speaker: Elderly Female Customer
entries.en: I have to agree. I hope he can work to[n]ease the anxieties of the elderly.

entries.speaker: Elderly Male Customer
entries.en: What do you think, Boss?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Hm? Oh sorry, I wasn't listening.
